title: The Stability Gap in Continual Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 持续强化学习中的稳定性缺口
abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) aims to enable agents to adapt to changing tasks while preserving previously acquired capabilities. Evaluation often relies on final aggregate metrics that can hide temporary performance degradation during adaptation. This work introduces a simple CRL benchmark that varies observation representations while preserving environment dynamics and rewards, supporting proof-of-concept demonstrations, inexpensive experimentation, and easily reproducible sanity checks. Using this benchmark, we demonstrate the stability gap in CRL: a substantial drop in prior-task performance after the introduction of new tasks, followed by partial or complete recovery. This pattern occurs despite the agent having complete access to past tasks.
abstract_zh: 持续强化学习（Continual Reinforcement Learning, CRL）旨在让智能体适应不断变化的任务，同时保留已习得的能力。然而，常用的最终汇总指标可能掩盖适应过程中的暂时性性能下降。本文提出一个简单的 CRL 基准：仅改变观测表征，保持环境动力学和奖励不变，以支持概念验证、低成本实验和易于复现的合理性检查。实验揭示了 CRL 中的稳定性缺口（stability gap）：引入新任务后，智能体在旧任务上的表现显著下降，随后部分或完全恢复。即使智能体仍可完整访问旧任务，这一现象也会发生。
key_points_zh: 基准仅改变观测表征，保持环境动力学与奖励不变，便于低成本实验和复现。
新任务引入后，旧任务表现先显著下降，再部分或完全恢复，这一现象称为稳定性缺口。
即使智能体仍可完整访问旧任务，稳定性缺口依然存在。
最终汇总指标可能掩盖适应期间的性能下滑，因此评估也应关注旧任务的性能轨迹。
